rules.acquired: Each Mastery level in the skill (3, 5, 7, 9 points) gives one perk step: one of its two perks at Tier I, or an upgrade of one you hold to Tier II (Tier I first). At 9 points both are at Tier II. Tier II replaces Tier I effects.
rules.mastered: 10 points: the skill's Mastered perk, granted automatically. One per skill.
rules.achieved: Combo perks. Mastery 2 (5 points) in every listed skill plus the deed. The engine grants the nine whose deeds it can watch in a fight (rules 1.14); the Narrator grants the other ten and may grant any by hand. The engine checks the skills and records the deed.
rules.ultimate: Granted automatically when both named Achieved perks are held. Secret: never listed, hinted or tracked in any UI until granted.

ap_cooldown.text: A perk or trait that gives AP on a condition gives it at most once every 3 of its holder's turns in a fight; a penalty side of the same item has the same limit, counted by itself.

squad takes the first casualty

II.text: If your squad makes the first kill of a fight and you had damaged that enemy, you have 3 more AP on your next turn, and whoever made the kill has 1 more AP on theirs.

effects.when: squad gets the first kill and you damaged that target
squad gets the first kill

items.name: Real Power
items.text: I: Once per organisation, ask who really holds the power in it, whatever the titles say. The Narrator tells you. II: Once per organisation, ask who really holds the power in it, whatever the titles say. The Narrator tells you, and that person agrees to see you; what they agree to after that is up to them.

effects.note: Tell the player who actually holds power in any organisation they're dealing with.

I.text: Once per organisation, ask who really holds the power in it, whatever the titles say. The Narrator tells you.

effects.note: Tell the player who actually holds power in any organisation they're dealing with.

II.text: Once per organisation, ask who really holds the power in it, whatever the titles say. The Narrator tells you, and that person agrees to see you; what they agree to after that is up to them.

effects.note: As Tier I, and that person agrees to meet the player.

items.name: Last Wall
items.flavour: The wall doesn't fall. The wall decides when it's done.
items.text: Once per fight, a hit that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 HP instead, and you take no damage at all until your next turn starts. Damage you do to yourself doesn't trigger it.

effects.when: would_drop_to_0
hp_floor_triggered

items.name: Walking Wounded
items.flavour: Hurt is information. You've read it all before.
items.text: Injuries never cost you AP or Movement: a head injury doesn't Daze you and a leg injury doesn't slow you. While you are below half your max HP, you take {=effects.1.value_pct}% less damage.

effects.when: hp below half

items.name: Skin Map
items.flavour: The air moves around them. The floor remembers their weight. You don't need eyes.
items.text: No enemy within {=effects.0.radius} tiles can stay Hidden from you. Darkness, smoke and invisibility don't stop you sensing it, though walls still do, and your own shots within {=effects.0.radius} tiles ignore smoke.

items.name: Earthbreaker
items.flavour: They took cover. You took the cover.
items.text: Once per fight, spend 4 AP to strike the ground at a tile within your melee reach. Everyone else in the 3×3 area around it, allies included, takes your melee damage with no roll and is knocked Prone. All cover and breakable objects in that area are destroyed.

items.name: Nothing Left to Fear
items.flavour: You've already met the worst thing. It blinked first.
items.text: You are immune to Fear. Allies within {=effects.1.radius} tiles who can see you can't be made Afraid, and an ally who starts a turn there stops being Afraid.

effects.when: ally can see you

items.name: The Name They Whisper
items.flavour: They tell stories about you to keep their recruits in line.
items.text: When a fight starts, every enemy makes a Heart save or is Afraid of you for 2 rounds. Only a stranger is spared: the Narrator says who has never heard of you. An enemy at half HP or less that can see you makes a Heart save at the end of its turn or surrenders. That works once per enemy, only while you are standing, and never on a boss.

effects.when: combat_start

effects.note: An enemy at half HP or less that can see this character and fails a Heart save at the end of its turn surrenders. The Narrator decides who 'knows who you are'.

items.name: Never There
items.flavour: Aim where they'll be. They won't be there either.
items.text: Your first move each turn draws no opportunity attacks and no Overwatch. On any later move that turn, ranged attacks made against you as you move are at {=effects.1.value} to hit.

effects.context: first move each turn provokes no reactions
ranged attacks against you during your move

items.name: Trick Shot
items.flavour: Off the pipe, off the plate, into the second one. You called it.
items.text: Once per turn, you can make a ranged attack a Ricochet. It ignores half cover, and if it hits, the nearest other enemy within 2 tiles of the target takes half the damage the target took.

effects.context: one ranged attack per turn

effects.target: second enemy within 2 tiles of the target
effects.when: ricochet hits

items.name: Before the Blink
items.flavour: Initiative is a polite word for who was faster. That was you.
items.text: You always act first in round 1, whatever you rolled for initiative. You have 2 reactions each round instead of 1.

items.name: Vanishing Act
items.flavour: Everyone saw you. Nobody can say where you went.
items.text: Once per fight, spend 2 AP to become Hidden where you stand, even in plain view. You stay Hidden until you attack, shove or release an Outburst, take damage, or an enemy ends its move next to you.

items.name: Overhaul
items.flavour: It left the factory good. It leaves your bench better.
items.text: Field Repair costs 1 AP and restores twice as much. After a long rest, you can give one weapon a permanent extra mod slot, once per weapon.

effects.when: long_rest

items.name: Nothing Gets Past
items.flavour: You held the line of sight. All of it.
items.text: Every enemy that moves in your sight is Spotted for free, exactly as your Spot Call would mark it. It costs no AP and no reaction, and works once per round on each enemy. It doesn't work while you are Silenced or Stunned.

effects.context: an enemy that moves in your sight; once a round for each enemy; no AP, no reaction

items.name: Clean Draw
items.flavour: No charge, no smoke, no Flux. Just the shape, perfectly.
items.text: Once per fight, for 0 AP, make your next Sigil spell a clean one. The glyphs you draw for it (up to 4) cost no Core charge and add no Flux, and Evoking it costs no charge either.

effects.context: one Sigil
that Sigil

items.name: Established Fact
items.flavour: You checked. It's true now.
items.text: Once per session, state a fact about the technology, biology or history in the scene. The Narrator makes it true, unless it contradicts something already shown. If the Narrator refuses the fact, you keep the use.

effects.note: Once per session the player states a fact about technology, biology or history in the scene. Make it true unless it contradicts something already established on screen.

items.name: Closing Argument
items.flavour: You didn't win the argument. You ended it.
items.text: Once per scene, make your closing argument. Every listener who isn't ruled by fear or faith accepts its logic, even if they hate where it leads, and an Eloquence check on the same point succeeds automatically. The Narrator decides what they do about it: they can still refuse to act.

effects.note: Once per scene: listening NPCs not driven by fear or faith concede the argument's logic. Acting on it remains their choice.

items.name: Solid Image
items.flavour: If you imagine it hard enough, it has edges.
items.text: Once per fight, for 0 AP, make one of your Mirage projections real until your next turn starts. A wall blocks movement and sight for everyone. A figure takes the first hit aimed at you or one of your allies, then breaks.

effects.context: a wall blocks movement and line of fire; a figure absorbs one hit aimed at an ally

items.name: Case Closed
items.flavour: Everything about them, in the order it matters.
items.text: Your Analyze reveals everything at once: HP, Defense, armour, resistances, saves, conditions and weak points, and the Narrator tells you what the target wants. You and your allies have +{=effects.1.value|abs} Defense against an enemy you have analyzed, and deal {=effects.2.value|more}% more damage to it.

effects.context: their attacks against you and your allies
against an enemy you have analyzed

items.name: Everyone's Friend
items.flavour: You've known them for ten minutes. They'd lend you their car.
items.text: Once per scene, pick one person who doesn't already hate you. Until the scene ends they treat you as a trusted friend and share what a friend would; the Narrator plays them. Your first lie to them succeeds automatically.

effects.note: One NPC who isn't hostile treats the character as a trusted friend for the scene.

effects.context: first lie to that NPC this scene

items.name: Open Hand
items.flavour: You saw the moment they stopped wanting this. So did they.
items.text: When an enemy you can see drops to a quarter of its HP or less, you can offer it mercy for 0 AP, once per enemy. It makes a Heart save or surrenders for the rest of the fight. Bosses and machines never accept.

effects.when: enemy in sight drops to 25% HP or less

items.name: Many Hands
items.flavour: Nobody on this squad fights alone. Not even you.
items.text: Your Hand-Off reaches any ally within {=effects.0.value} tiles, not only one next to you. An ally you can see who has already used their reaction may use yours instead.

effects.context: Hand-Off (Camaraderie 3): an ally within 3 tiles uses your Defense
an ally in sight may spend your reaction as theirs

items.name: Their Own Idea
items.flavour: You never told them. You just let them get there.
items.text: Once per scene, hide a suggestion inside a sentence. The listener believes it was their own idea and acts on it; the Narrator plays how. It fails if it would harm them directly, and an important or supernatural listener gets a Heart save against your Insinuation.

effects.note: Once per scene the listener adopts the hidden suggestion as their own idea and acts on it, unless it is directly self-harmful.

items.name: The Twin Pays
items.flavour: Up there, someone with your face flinches. Down here, the spell lands.
items.text: Once per fight, when you Begin an Outburst, choose The Twin Pays: the Begin costs no AP, no mana and no Strain, and holding it costs no Strain. Your twin in the upper realm pays for it.

effects.context: one Soul spell
that spell

items.name: True Name
items.flavour: You know what it's called. It knows you know.
items.text: Once per session, for 0 AP, speak the true name of an upper-realm being, a cursed thing or a creature. It must have been Analyzed first. For the rest of the scene it takes {=effects.0.value|more}% more damage from you and your allies, and it can't lie to you; the Narrator plays that.

effects.context: vs the named being, rest of the scene

effects.note: The named being can't lie to this character for the scene. The Narrator confirms the character has studied it.

items.name: Still Water
items.flavour: Nothing goes in. Nothing comes out.
items.text: You are immune to Brain debuffs. Enemies can't read you: not your intent, your lies or your HP, not even with Analyze or Empathy. Your allies still can.

effects.context: Analyze, Empathy and lie-reading reveal nothing

items.name: Judgement Day
items.flavour: The saints have looked. They've decided.
items.text: Once per fight, spend 3 AP to judge one enemy you can see. Its next attack against you or an ally fails automatically, and your attacks deal {=effects.0.effects.1.value|more}% more damage to it until the fight ends.

effects.context: your attacks vs the judged enemy

items.name: Foreseen
items.flavour: You saw where it led. This time you take the other road.
items.text: Once per session, after a major decision goes wrong, rewind to just before it. Everyone at the table has to agree. Everything since is undone, the Narrator tells you what would have happened, and you choose again.

effects.note: Once per session, rewind one major decision that went wrong: describe the outcome that would have followed, then let the player choose again.

items.name: On My Mark
items.flavour: You say go. They're already gone.
items.text: Once per round, on your turn, spend 1 AP to order an ally who can hear you. They take one action at once, outside their turn, with up to 4 AP. The AP they spend comes off their next turn.

effects.context: one action now, paid from the ally's AP

items.name: Charge!

requires.deed: open a fight by charging the enemy line, and win it.

items.deed: open a fight by charging the enemy line, and win it.
items.text: Once per turn, when you move 3 or more tiles in a straight line and end next to an enemy you can see, up to 3 AP of that move is free.

effects.when: straight-line charge of 3+ tiles at an enemy

items.name: Make Way

requires.deed: walk through a hostile crowd with no weapon drawn.

items.deed: walk through a hostile crowd with no weapon drawn.
items.text: Moving past enemies never draws opportunity attacks from them; Overwatch can still fire. Crowds part for you: bystanders don't block your path, and the Narrator plays the rest.

effects.note: Crowds part for this character.

items.name: Just the Repairman

requires.deed: talk your way past a guard who caught you somewhere you shouldn't be.

items.deed: talk your way past a guard who caught you somewhere you shouldn't be.
items.text: While you carry a toolbox: when someone spots you sneaking, there is a {=effects.0.value|pct}% chance they take you for maintenance staff and you stay hidden from them. They don't look again that scene unless you attack.

effects.when: spotted while sneaking, carrying a toolbox
effects.result: observer treats you as maintenance staff

items.name: Spoon-Feed
items.text: Spend 2 AP to explain one visible enemy's weakness so simply that anyone can use it. Every ally within 6 tiles gets +2 to hit that enemy until your next turn starts.

effects.context: vs the named enemy

items.name: Cultured

requires.deed: win someone over with a story, a song or a painting.

items.deed: win someone over with a story, a song or a painting.
items.text: You have +{=effects.0.value} on Ingenuity and Charisma checks whenever the talk turns to art, history or holo-dramas: you blend in with anyone who loves them. The Narrator decides when that applies.

effects.when: talk turns to art, history or holo-dramas
talk turns to art, history or holo-dramas

items.name: Field Surgeon

requires.deed: bring a squadmate back from below 10% HP.

items.deed: bring a squadmate back from below 10% HP.
items.text: Your Field Repair works on a living ally next to you, for its usual AP and one spare-parts charge: it heals 3 HP per point of your Improvisation, raised by your Healing given and your level, and it gets a Downed ally back on their feet. Your heals on robotic allies work at full power.

effects.context: robotic allies (removes any robot healing penalty)

items.name: Dance of Iron

requires.deed: dodge three attacks in one round.

items.deed: dodge three attacks in one round.
items.text: When an attack against you misses, you fire one shot back at the attacker for {=effects.0.ap} AP. This uses your reaction, and you need a loaded ranged weapon with the attacker in sight and in range.

effects.when: successful dodge

items.name: Cold Read

requires.deed: close a case with a confession.

items.deed: close a case with a confession.
items.text: Whenever you Analyze someone, the Narrator also tells you privately what they want most.

effects.note: When the player Analyzes an NPC, also tell them what that NPC wants most.

items.name: Fire Sermon
items.text: Spend 2 AP to preach; you can't while Silenced. Until your next turn starts, every Blessing you pray also forces each enemy within 4 tiles to make a Heart save or be Shaken.

effects.when: you grant a Blessing while preaching

items.name: Silent Partner

requires.deed: get the whole squad through a guarded area unseen.

items.deed: get the whole squad through a guarded area unseen.
items.text: When you hide, one ally next to you becomes Hidden with you. They lose it when they end a move away from you, or when you are found.

items.name: Verse of War

requires.deed: cast an Outburst that ends a fight, and say something worth remembering while you do it.

items.deed: cast an Outburst that ends a fight, and say something worth remembering while you do it.
items.text: Speak a line of verse, then Begin or Release an Outburst with In verse on: it gets +{=effects.0.value} tile of range and +{=effects.1.value|more}% damage.

effects.when: player speaks in verse while casting

effects.context: Soul spells cast while speaking in verse

items.name: Between Heartbeats

requires.deed: come through an ambush without being hit.

items.deed: come through an ambush without being hit.
items.text: Once per fight, when an enemy you can see starts an action, you act first with 2 free AP: a shot at it, a move, dropping Prone, a stim for an ally next to you, or a reload. You choose which on your turn, and it waits until an enemy sets it off. It doesn't use your reaction.

effects.trigger: an enemy in your sight starts an action

items.name: Siege Engine

requires.deed: break through a wall to win a fight.

items.deed: break through a wall to win a fight.
items.text: Shove and the Break Finisher cost you 1 AP less, never below 1 AP. A Shove that moves its target gives you 1 Guard. Nothing can push you or knock you back.

items.name: Dead Signal

requires.deed: shut down a security system without anyone noticing.

items.deed: shut down a security system without anyone noticing.
items.text: While you are Hidden or no enemy can see you, spend 1 AP to silently disable one electronic device within {=effects.0.range} tiles: a lamp goes dark, a lock opens, a camera, alarm, terminal or turret stops working.

items.name: Twin Souls
items.text: Once per session, outside a fight, ask your twin soul in the upper realm one question; the Narrator answers truthfully. Your Outbursts can also carry a third school, as a rider at half strength, for 20 more MP.

effects.note: Once per session, answer one question as the player's twin soul in the upper realm.

effects.context: a third school as a rider at half strength, +20 MP

items.name: The Voice

requires.deed: stare down an enemy officer until they back off.

items.deed: stare down an enemy officer until they back off.
items.text: Once per session, in a fight, give an order for 0 AP. Every rank-and-file enemy within 8 tiles makes a Heart save or obeys it on its next turn: halt, hold fire, drop its weapon, kneel or fall back. Elites and bosses ignore it, and the Narrator decides what any other order does.

items.name: Bite the Bullet

requires.deed: fight through an entire combat below a quarter of your max HP.

items.deed: fight through an entire combat below a quarter of your max HP.
items.text: Once per fight, when you would drop to 0 HP, you stay on your feet until the end of your next turn (or of this turn, if it is yours). Until then every hit you take is a failed death save instead of damage. At the end of it you go Downed, unless you have been healed.

effects.when: would_drop_to_0
effects.context: act one full turn, then drop unless healed above 0

items.name: Sixth Sense

requires.deed: catch someone tailing the squad before they strike.

items.deed: catch someone tailing the squad before they strike.
items.text: Hidden enemies within {=effects.0.radius} tiles of you are revealed to you and your whole squad, even through walls.

items.name: What Could Be

requires.deed: talk someone out of a terrible choice by showing them where it leads.

items.deed: talk someone out of a terrible choice by showing them where it leads.
items.text: Once per session, before a major decision, ask for a vision. The Narrator shows you the best outcome within reach, and one way to get there.

effects.note: Once per session, before a major decision: describe the best reachable outcome and one honest route to it. It can still fail.

items.name: War Footing
items.flavour: The Hellraisers call it marching on the enemy's nerves.
items.text: Your threats never backfire: a failed Intimidation check costs you nothing, though you can't try again on the same person that scene. An enemy that ends a move next to you loses {=effects.1.effect.value|abs} AP at once, unless it Disengaged. Once every 3 turns.

effects.when: enemy ends its move in the aura

items.name: Last Charge
items.flavour: Every army has a song for running at guns. You know all of them.
items.text: When you charge 5 or more tiles in a straight line at an enemy, your melee hits deal ×{=effects.1.value} damage for the rest of that turn. Once per fight, that charge also gives you a shield of 15 × your Armour Class (at least 15) until your next turn starts.

effects.when: after a charge of 5+ tiles (7 m at 1.5 m per tile)

effects.context: melee hits made during the charge

items.name: Angel of the Trenches
items.flavour: The 258th Medical Unit's highest honour has no medal. The soldiers just say your name.
items.text: Once per fight, when an ally you could reach with 1 AP of movement would drop to 0 HP, you run to them out of turn for {=effects.0.ap} AP and stabilise them: they stay up at 1 HP and stop Bleeding. The run draws no opportunity attacks. Choose Hold position on your turn if you would rather stay put.

effects.trigger: an ally within your Movement would drop to 0 HP

items.name: Every Lie Is a Door
items.flavour: You don't break in. You get invited.
items.text: Once per session, walk into any guarded place by naming a reason to be there. You alone are believed, and its guards don't notice you sneaking, until a weapon is drawn, a fight starts or the scene ends. The Narrator plays the people you meet.

effects.note: Once per session, the player names a reason to be in a guarded place; guards believe it until someone draws a weapon.

items.name: Twin Discipline
items.flavour: The Science Team says it can't be done. The Institute says it shouldn't be. You do it anyway.
items.text: While you hold a begun Outburst, Evoke a Sigil Line as one fused cast. The Sigil's words set where it reaches and what it covers; the Outburst sets the school and the stage, and each creature it covers takes it as a Bolt. You pay both costs.

items.name: Supreme Command
items.flavour: Five stars, and nobody looks you in the eye.
items.text: Once per fight, on your turn, give one order to the whole squad for 0 AP. Every other conscious squadmate takes one action of up to {=effects.1.ap} AP at once, for free.

effects.when: supreme_command
